description: Interior of a large timber-roofed hall with arched stone windows and tiered wooden galleries where men in black caps and fur-trimmed red and black robes sit. In the foreground an old bearded man in a plain dark gown leans on a wooden staff, looking up. A shadowy figure stands at left, a clerk writes at a desk at lower right, and candles stand on posts. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
